item.title: Verbraucherlaune vor US-Kongresswahlen eingetrübt - Frust über hohe Preise
item.description: Die Stimmung der Verbraucher in den USA hat sich im Oktober und damit wenige Wochen vor den Zwischenwahlen stärker als erwartet eingetrübt. Das Barometer für die Konsumlaune sank auf 46,3 Zähler, nach 48,1 Punkten im September, wie die Universität Michigan am Freitag mitteilte. Von Reuters befragte Ökonomen hatten nur mit einem Rückgang auf 47,8 Punkte gerechnet. "Der Frust über die Lebenshaltungskosten wächst weiter, da Verbraucher über das gesamte politische Spektrum hinweg der Ansicht sind, dass sich die wirtschaftliche Entwicklung seit Jahresbeginn abgeschwächt hat", erläuterte Joanne Hsu, die für die Verbraucherumfragen zuständig ist.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Die Stimmung der Verbraucher in den USA hat sich im Oktober und damit wenige Wochen vor den Zwischenwahlen stärker als erwartet eingetrübt. Das Barometer für die Konsumlaune sank auf 46,3 Zähler, nach 48,1 Punkten im September, wie die Universität Michigan am Freitag mitteilte. Von Reuters befragte Ökonomen hatten nur mit einem Rückgang auf 47,8 Punkte gerechnet. "Der Frust über die Lebenshaltungskosten wächst weiter, da Verbraucher über das gesamte politische Spektrum hinweg der Ansicht sind, dass sich die wirtschaftliche Entwicklung seit Jahresbeginn abgeschwächt hat", erläuterte Joanne Hsu, die für die Verbraucherumfragen zuständig ist. Vor den Zwischenwahlen am 3. November setzen die hohen Benzinpreise die Republikaner von US-Präsident Donald Trump unter Druck und gefährden ihre Mehrheit im Kongress. Trump erklärte wiederholt, er erwarte nach den Wahlen einen deutlichen Rückgang der Ölpreise. Worauf er seine Hoffnung stützt, ist unklar. Die USA und der Iran haben in den vergangenen Wochen Vorschläge ausgetauscht, um den Krieg zu beenden und die für die globalen Öl- und Gaslieferungen wichtige Straße von Hormus wieder zu öffnen. Der Iran blockiert die Meerenge seit Monaten weitgehend. Trump war im Januar 2025 mit dem Versprechen ins Weiße Haus zurückgekehrt, die Inflation einzudämmen und Kriege im Ausland zu beenden. Bei den Kongresswahlen wollen seine Republikaner knappe Mehrheiten verteidigen. Ein Verlust der Kontrolle über den Senat oder das Repräsentantenhaus könnte Trumps politische Vorhaben in den letzten beiden Jahren seiner Amtszeit erschweren.

item.title: EUA impõem sanções ao TPI poucas horas depois de ex-juíza ganhar Nobel da Paz
item.description: O governo do presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump, impôs sanções ao Tribunal Penal Internacional (TPI) na sexta-feira, poucas horas depois que uma de suas ex-juízas ganhou o Prêmio Nobel da Paz, colocando Washington em rota de colisão diplomática com seus aliados europeus.
item.dc:creator: Humeyra Pamuk, Steve Holland
item.content:encoded: O governo do presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump, impôs sanções ao Tribunal Penal Internacional (TPI) na sexta-feira, poucas horas depois que uma de suas ex-juízas ganhou o Prêmio Nobel da Paz, colocando Washington em rota de colisão diplomática com seus aliados europeus. A vice-promotora do TPI Nazhat Shameem Khan condenou as sanções e afirmou que elas não impedirão o trabalho do tribunal. O governo Trump há muito tempo mantém uma postura hostil em relação ao tribunal e já havia imposto sanções a seus promotores e juízes. A medida tomada na sexta-feira vai muito além, pois poderia punir empresas que prestam serviços ao próprio tribunal. “O presidente Trump nunca permitirá que o Tribunal Penal Internacional julgue norte-americanos”, afirmou o secretário de Estado Marco Rubio em comunicado visto pela Reuters antes do anúncio oficial. “É por isso que, hoje, os Estados Unidos estão impondo sanções ao Tribunal Penal Internacional. Proibiremos transações com esse tribunal desonesto, cortando seus recursos e paralisando sua capacidade de operar.” A vice-promotora Khan disse à Reuters que as sanções "precisam ser condenadas". "As sanções visam minar o Estado de Direito em nível internacional e o trabalho que uma instituição judiciária independente está realizando", afirmou Khan. "Nosso trabalho continuará em todas as nossas situações, investigações e ações judiciais." Washington há muito tempo mostra indignação com os mandados de prisão emitidos pelo TPI contra autoridades israelenses, incluindo o primeiro-ministro Benjamin Netanyahu, e com uma investigação anterior sobre ações de soldados norte-americanos no Afeganistão, que o TPI já encerrou. O tribunal, fundado em 2002 para julgar crimes de guerra, crimes contra a humanidade e genocídio, conta com 125 países como Estados membros, incluindo todos os países da União Europeia e todos os membros da Otan, com exceção dos Estados Unidos e da Turquia. No passado, o tribunal recebeu forte apoio público dos países membros, incluindo os principais aliados dos EUA, e está sediado na Holanda, membro da União Europeia e da Otan. Navi Pillay, jurista sul-africana que ganhou na sexta-feira o Prêmio Nobel da Paz por seu trabalho na justiça criminal internacional, atuou como juíza na Câmara de Apelações do TPI de 2003 a 2008. Em sua justificativa, o comitê do prêmio afirmou que buscou “fazer um lembrete” em um momento em que “juízes e instituições do direito internacional estão sob ataque político”. “Um sistema jurídico internacional no qual criminosos de guerra sejam responsabilizados e as vítimas de abusos vejam a justiça ser feita é uma condição prévia para um mundo pacífico”, acrescentou o comitê. Rubio disse que as sanções foram estruturadas para dar ao tribunal e aos seus Estados membros a oportunidade de abordar as preocupações dos EUA. Ele não forneceu mais detalhes, mas uma autoridade de alto escalão do Departamento de Estado disse que o Tesouro dos EUA emitiria um conjunto de licenças “para proteger os interesses norte-americanos”, uma aparente referência a isenções temporárias de algumas sanções. As sanções dos EUA normalmente impedem todas as empresas sediadas nos EUA de realizar qualquer trabalho com uma organização sancionada, forçando bancos a encerrar contas, seguradoras a encerrar coberturas e empresas de software a interromper a cooperação. O governo Trump já havia imposto sanções direcionadas a funcionários do tribunal durante seu primeiro mandato, as quais foram revogadas pelo presidente norte-americano Joe Biden. Washington anunciou novas sanções poucos dias após Trump retornar ao cargo, em janeiro de 2025. Funcionários do tribunal vêm se preparando há meses para a possibilidade de sanções contra o próprio tribunal, substituindo os softwares da Microsoft nos computadores do escritório por equivalentes de código aberto e tomando novas providências em relação a serviços bancários e de seguro saúde.

item.title: Manifestantes se enfrentan a la policía en Bruselas durante marcha de sindicatos y estudiantes
item.description: Un pequeño grupo de manifestantes se enfrentó a la policía el viernes en Bruselas, mientras miembros de los sindicatos, a los que se unieron cientos de estudiantes, se manifestaban en el marco de una huelga nacional contra los recortes presupuestarios previstos por el Gobierno.
item.dc:creator: Marta Fiorin, Bart Biesemans
item.content:encoded: Un pequeño grupo de manifestantes se enfrentó a la policía el viernes en Bruselas, mientras miembros de los sindicatos, a los que se unieron cientos de estudiantes, se manifestaban en el marco de una huelga nacional contra los recortes presupuestarios previstos por el Gobierno. Varias decenas de manifestantes enmascarados y vestidos de negro lanzaron piedras y otros objetos contra la policía, mientras las calles resonaban con consignas contra las fuerzas del orden y los muros cercanos estaban cubiertos de grafitis contra la policía. Los bomberos extinguieron varios incendios, incluso en autobuses, mientras que la policía respondió con gas lacrimógeno, según testigos de Reuters. Los enfrentamientos se produjeron mientras miles de manifestantes salían a las calles de la capital belga, entre ellos estudiantes inspirados en parte por las manifestaciones en la vecina Francia. La huelga interrumpió el transporte público y el tráfico aéreo, y también afectó a muchos colegios y guarderías. Entre los manifestantes, algunos llevaban pancartas en las que se leía "Me he saltado clase para defender la clase" y "La educación es un derecho, no un privilegio". La huelga belga forma parte de una ola de protestas que se extiende por Europa, en la que estudiantes de Francia e Italia, entre otros países, han salido a la calle para reclamar financiación para la educación, mientras que en España decenas de miles de personas se han manifestado por la crisis de la vivienda. La policía dijo que, aunque la marcha en sí, a la que se sumaron unas 30.000 personas, transcurrió de forma pacífica, hubo enfrentamientos cerca de la estación central de Bruselas y en el centro, donde algunos grupos lanzaron botellas, ladrillos, piedras y fuegos artificiales contra la policía, provocaron incendios y causaron daños a la propiedad pública. Las autoridades indicaron que los agentes utilizaron cañones de agua y gas lacrimógeno para dispersar a los grupos y que 21 personas fueron detenidas, entre ellas 13 menores. La huelga fue convocada por los dos sindicatos más importantes, el socialista FGTB/ABVV y el cristiano CSC/ACV, que se oponen a unas medidas presupuestarias que, según afirman, harían que los trabajadores, los jubilados y los hogares con bajos ingresos cargaran con el peso de los esfuerzos para reducir el déficit del país.

item.title: Recientes medidas de Turquía alejan al país de su objetivo de adhesión a la UE, dice comisaria del bloque
item.description: Turquía se está alejando cada vez más de su objetivo de adherirse a la Unión Europea debido a sus recientes medidas de represión contra la comunidad LGBTQ+ y de restricción de la libertad de prensa, dijo el viernes la comisaria de Ampliación de la UE.
item.dc:creator: Tuvan Gumrukcu
item.content:encoded: Turquía se está alejando cada vez más de su objetivo de adherirse a la Unión Europea debido a sus recientes medidas de represión contra la comunidad LGBTQ+ y de restricción de la libertad de prensa, dijo el viernes la comisaria de Ampliación de la UE. Turquía es candidata oficial a la adhesión a la UE desde 1999, pero su adhesión lleva mucho tiempo congelada debido a cuestiones que van desde su historial en materia de derechos humanos hasta el retroceso democrático. La semana pasada, un tribunal turco ordenó bloquear el acceso a la página web y a las cuentas en redes sociales del medio de comunicación independiente T24 después de que las autoridades afirmaran que había publicado 118 contenidos durante el último año que se consideraban "propaganda LGBT". La decisión se tomó en el marco de la investigación "Mi familia está a salvo", una campaña de represión cada vez más amplia dirigida contra los grupos LGBTQ+ que, según el Gobierno, tiene como objetivo proteger a los niños y los valores familiares, pero que ha suscitado duras críticas por parte de organizaciones de derechos humanos y de la UE. En declaraciones a los periodistas en la provincia noroccidental de Edirne, donde asistió a la inauguración de un proyecto ferroviario financiado por la UE, la comisaria Marta Kos afirmó que la Unión tenía un gran interés en desarrollar una relación de cooperación y beneficio mutuo con Turquía a la luz de las "nuevas realidades" en Europa, pero que persistían las preocupaciones sobre los estándares democráticos. "Los últimos acontecimientos que afectan a la libertad de prensa, los derechos de las personas LGBTQI+ y la democracia local están ampliando la brecha con respecto al objetivo de Turquía de adherirse a la UE", señaló Kos. El informe anual de la UE sobre la ampliación, que se publicará el 28 de octubre, reflejará "nuestras serias preocupaciones en estos ámbitos", señaló Kos, y añadió que "no dudará en exponer los hechos de forma pública y clara". El Gobierno turco no reaccionó de inmediato a las declaraciones de Kos. AUMENTA LA NECESIDAD DE COOPERACIÓN, AFIRMA KOS A pesar de la falta de avances en sus aspiraciones de adhesión, Turquía ha buscado aumentar la cooperación con la UE. Ha pedido en repetidas ocasiones la actualización de su unión aduanera con el bloque y ha solicitado participar en diversos programas de la UE. Entre ellos se incluyen la Iniciativa de Acción para la Seguridad en Europa, que ayuda a los Estados miembros a realizar inversiones en defensa; la iniciativa de la Zona Única de Pagos en Euros, que facilita las transferencias bancarias en euros sin efectivo; y sus normas "Made in Europe", destinadas a impulsar la fabricación nacional. Kos afirmó que los conflictos en la región, especialmente la expansión de la guerra entre Rusia y Ucrania hacia el mar Negro, ponían de manifiesto la importancia y la necesidad de la cooperación con Turquía. Kos señaló que la UE tiene actualmente dos líneas de trabajo en curso con Turquía, centradas en una "actualización específica" de la unión aduanera y otra en la contratación pública.

item.title: Canada’s 2026 job gains have been erased. The hardest-hit area wasn’t the one facing U.S. tariffs.
item.description: Canada’s economy stunned widespread expectations to post a massive job loss in September and the unemployment rate edged up, data showed on Friday, effectively wiping off all the gains in jobs seen ...
item.dc:creator: Reuters Staff
item.content:encoded: OTTAWA -- Canada’s economy stunned widespread expectations to post a massive job loss in September and the unemployment rate edged up, data showed on Friday, effectively wiping off all the gains in jobs seen this year. The economy lost a net of 68,300 jobs in September after a loss of 41,700 positions in August, Statistics Canada said. It said the unemployment level inched up to 6.5 per cent. While September was the first full month of employment report after a new set of tariffs from the United States hit Canada, the job losses were not significantly higher in U.S.-facing industries. On the contrary, the biggest drop came from public sector employees, data showed. Analysts polled by Reuters had forecast jobs gains of 9,200 and predicted the employment rate at 6.5 per cent, up from 6.4 per cent in August. With the September report, Canada has effectively lost a net of 41,200 jobs this year, as against a solid gain of 211,300 seen for the same period a year ago. The losses were almost equally divided between full-time and part-time workers and was led by educational services and healthcare and social assistance. Both the sectors form a substantial chunk of public sector employees and together lost 58,400 jobs. A smaller number of international students coming into Canada was one of the reasons for decline in jobs in education services, StatCan said. The manufacturing sector, a part of which is exposed to U.S., saw a net decline of 12,700 jobs. Economists have said that the new U.S. tariffs impact only a small section of the jobs that are dependent on the U.S. and is not likely to have a major impact on the employment data in the coming months. The September employment report is also the last set of job data before the Bank of Canada’s monetary policy decision announcement end of this month. Money markets are pricing in no hike in October but the bets for a 25 basis point hike were slowly creeping up before the jobs data was released. Markets expect a 25 basis point hike in December. The labour force participation rate, or the share of the population who are either employed or looking for work, fell 0.2 percentage points to 64.8 per cent in September, its lowest level in 29 years barring the pandemic era. This was primarily due to an aging of population who are dropping off the work force, and not being replaced due to slower immigration. Employment among the youth, or those aged between 15 and 24, declined in September and dropped by 48,000, following a smaller decline in August. Immigration control is also part of the reason for this decline. The labour force continued to shrink in September, data showed. The growth rate of permanent employees’ average hourly wages, a gauge of inflation, rose to 2.3 per cent year-over-year in September after dropping to two per cent in August, StatCan said. The Canadian dollar weakened after the jobs report and was trading down 0.44 per cent at $1.4287 to the U.S. dollar, or 69.99 U.S. cents. Yields on the two-year government bonds reversed early moves and were trading down 9.5 basis points to 2.410 per cent. (Reporting by Promit Mukherjee; Editing by Dale Smith)

item.title: Vier Ukrainer unter Spionageverdacht in Wien festgenommen
item.description: In Wien sind in dieser Woche vier ukrainische Staatsbürger unter dem Verdacht der Spionage festgenommen worden. Das bestätigte das österreichische Innenministerium am Freitag der Nachrichtenagentur Reuters. Zwei der Verdächtigen seien am Montag festgenommen worden, zwei weitere am Donnerstag, sagte Innenminister Gerhard Karner. "Drei dieser ukrainischen Staatsbürger sind nach wie vor in Haft. item.content:encoded: In Wien sind in dieser Woche vier ukrainische Staatsbürger unter dem Verdacht der Spionage festgenommen worden. Das bestätigte das österreichische Innenministerium am Freitag der Nachrichtenagentur Reuters. Zwei der Verdächtigen seien am Montag festgenommen worden, zwei weitere am Donnerstag, sagte Innenminister Gerhard Karner. "Drei dieser ukrainischen Staatsbürger sind nach wie vor in Haft. Eine Person wurde mittlerweile wieder auf freien Fuß gesetzt", erklärte der Minister. Die Festnahmen erfolgten dem Ministerium zufolge im Auftrag der Staatsanwaltschaft Wien. Das Innenministerium lehnte weitere Details mit Verweis auf die laufenden Ermittlungen ab. Die Staatsanwaltschaft Wien war für Reuters zunächst nicht zu erreichen.

item.title: China e UE chegam a acordo sobre veículos híbridos e mantêm negociações sobre veículos elétricos
item.description: A China e a União Europeia chegaram a um “acordo” sobre o comércio de veículos híbridos, informou o Ministério do Comércio chinês nesta sexta-feira, após dois dias de negociações nas quais o bloco buscou reduzir seu déficit comercial com Pequim.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A China e a União Europeia chegaram a um “acordo” sobre o comércio de veículos híbridos, informou o Ministério do Comércio chinês nesta sexta-feira, após dois dias de negociações nas quais o bloco buscou reduzir seu déficit comercial com Pequim. O comissário europeu de Comércio, Maros Sefcovic, afirmou que buscava “resultados tangíveis” em sua visita à China, em meio às crescentes preocupações do bloco com o déficit, que chegava a mais de 1 bilhão de euros (US$1,12 bilhão) por dia. O entendimento sobre o comércio de veículos híbridos, em conformidade com as regras da Organização Mundial do Comércio (OMC), foi alcançado após intensas negociações, informou o ministério chinês, sem fornecer detalhes. Questionada se a declaração chinesa era conjunta, a Comissão Europeia informou que Sefcovic se pronunciaria sobre as negociações em uma coletiva de imprensa. Autoridades da UE estão preocupadas com o forte aumento nas importações de automóveis da China. As importações de híbridos recarregáveis para a UE aumentaram 86% no período até setembro, com uma queda de 20% nos preços. Mais da metade desses veículos é agora proveniente da China, enquanto, em 2025, a participação da China nas importações de PHEV era de 30% em termos de valor. As discussões entre o ministro do Comércio chinês, Wang Wentao, e Sefcovic, em Pequim, na quinta e nesta sexta-feira, foram “pragmáticas e produtivas”, informou o ministério chinês. A China e a UE também concordaram em continuar as discussões sobre compromissos de preços e procedimentos de revisão relacionados à investigação antissubvenção da UE sobre veículos elétricos chineses, segundo o ministério. A disputa entre a China e a UE sobre as exportações baratas de veículos elétricos chineses, que remonta a 2024, tem prejudicado as relações bilaterais e, desde então, se ampliou para incluir setores como conhaque, carne suína e laticínios, bem como terras raras e minerais críticos. A China precisa de compradores estrangeiros para absorver a enxurrada de produtos baratos e subsidiados pelo Estado que seus próprios consumidores não conseguem absorver, e a UE está dividida entre acolher essas importações para aliviar o custo de vida e mantê-las fora para reconstruir suas próprias fábricas. Ambos os lados continuarão explorando a possibilidade de reduzir as tarifas sobre certos produtos dentro da estrutura das regras da OMC e darão continuidade ao diálogo sobre o acesso ao mercado para dispositivos médicos, informou o ministério chinês. Uma terceira reunião ordinária do mecanismo de consulta ocorrerá em março de 2027, e as duas partes concordaram em manter a comunicação, incluindo uma videoconferência em nível ministerial em janeiro, informou o ministério. (Reportagem de Qiaoyi Li, Yukun Zhang e Joe Cash; Reportagem adicional de Philip Blenkinsop, em Bruxelas)

item.title: EU-Minister erzielen Kompromiss zur zentralisierten Kapitalmarktaufsicht
item.description: Die Finanzminister der Europäischen Union haben sich auf einen Kompromiss zur Zentralisierung der Aufsicht über die meisten EU-Börsen geeinigt. Ziel des sogenannten Marktintegrationspakets (MISP) ist es, die Funktionsweise der EU-Kapitalmärkte zu verbessern. Die Vereinbarung vom Freitag zielt darauf ab, die Zersplitterung der 27 unterschiedlichen Rechtssysteme zu verringern, die den Kapitalfluss regeln. Damit soll die EU für innovative Unternehmen attraktiver werden, die sich derzeit häufig für eine Verlagerung in die USA entscheiden.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Die Finanzminister der Europäischen Union haben sich auf einen Kompromiss zur Zentralisierung der Aufsicht über die meisten EU-Börsen geeinigt. Ziel des sogenannten Marktintegrationspakets (MISP) ist es, die Funktionsweise der EU-Kapitalmärkte zu verbessern. Die Vereinbarung vom Freitag zielt darauf ab, die Zersplitterung der 27 unterschiedlichen Rechtssysteme zu verringern, die den Kapitalfluss regeln. Damit soll die EU für innovative Unternehmen attraktiver werden, die sich derzeit häufig für eine Verlagerung in die USA entscheiden. Der Kompromiss unterscheidet sich jedoch von dem ursprünglichen Vorschlag der EU-Kommission für das Paket zur Marktintegration und -aufsicht. Dieser sah vor, dass sämtliche Börsen, großen zentralen Gegenparteien (CCPs) und Wertpapierzentralverwahrer (CSDs) von der Europäischen Wertpapier- und Marktaufsichtsbehörde (ESMA) in Paris beaufsichtigt werden sollten – anstatt wie bisher von nationalen Behörden. KLINGBEIL: "GANZ ENTSCHEIDENDER SCHRITT" Die Idee bestand darin, eine einheitliche Anwendung der EU-Vorschriften in allen Mitgliedstaaten zu gewährleisten und nationale Auslegungen zu beseitigen, um so Kosten und Bürokratie zu reduzieren. Deutschland sperrte sich jedoch gegen den Vorschlag, solange die Deutsche Börse (DB1Gn.DE) nicht weiterhin der nationalen deutschen Aufsicht unterstand. Der ausgehandelte Kompromiss sieht Schwellenwerte für das Handelsvolumen sowie Kriterien zur geografischen Präsenz vor, durch die die Deutsche Börse von der Aufsicht durch die ESMA ausgenommen werden kann. Von der Regelung ausgenommen sind auch der Schweizer Börsenbetreiber SIX Group (zu dem die Börse Madrid gehört), das französische Unternehmen Tradition sowie die zur Deutschen Börse gehörende elektronische Handelsplattform Tradegate (T2GG.F) . Bundesfinanzminister Lars Klingbeil würdigte den Kompromiss als wichtigen Schritt hin zur europäischen Integration: "Es geht um neue Arbeitsplätze, um Innovationen und Wachstum. Dafür ist die Kapitalmarktunion ein echter Gamechanger." Die nun erzielte Einigung sei ein "ganz entscheidender Schritt" auf dem Weg dahin. "Das Paket ist das Herzstück der Gesetzgebung, mit der wir die Integration der europäischen Kapitalmärkte vorantreiben, damit Kapital leichter für Investitionen in Europa zur Verfügung steht", fügte der SPD-Politiker hinzu.

item.title: Knicks table contract talks for Karl-Anthony Towns, others
item.description: The New York Knicks are pausing potential contract extensions until later in the season, the team announced Friday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The New York Knicks are pausing potential contract extensions until later in the season, the team announced Friday. The news affects All-Star center Karl-Anthony Towns and guards Josh Hart, Miles McBride and Tyler Kolek. Each is eligible for an extension and the Knicks have until June 30 to get those deals done. "As an organization, our entire focus is on preparing for the upcoming season and delivering another year for our fans to be proud of," a Knicks spokesman said. "As a result, we will not be negotiating contract extensions until later in the season and will remain solely focused on preparing for the start of the season." Towns, the Knicks' All-Star center and a centerpiece in New York's championship season, said he didn't expect an agreement to be reached prior to the season. "It don't look good," Towns said Monday. "I want to do something that can keep the team together and work with the Knicks and also values me. None of those things have come close to happening." Towns, 30, is owed $57 million this season and has a $61.1 million player option for 2027-28. He is eligible for a four-year extension worth a maximum of $276 million. In last season's playoffs, Towns averaged 15.9 points, 10.6 rebounds and 4.9 assists as the Knicks halted a 53-year title drought by taking down the San Antonio Spurs in five games in the NBA Finals. --Field Level Media

item.title: Thieves make off with tens of thousands of wine bottles worth millions
item.description: Thieves stole around 30,000 bottles of premium wine worth about €5 million (US$5.8 million) from a Marchesi Antinori warehouse in Tuscany, Italy’s largest family-run winemaker said on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters Staff
item.content:encoded: ROME -- Thieves stole around 30,000 bottles of premium wine worth about €5 million (US$5.8 million) from a Marchesi Antinori warehouse in Tuscany, Italy’s largest family-run winemaker said on Friday. Antinori, which dates back to 1385 and now exports to 170 countries, has alerted customers worldwide to be wary of offers outside official sales channels following last weekend’s heist and is still hopeful of recovering the stolen wine. It said the thieves took 8,000 to 10,000 bottles of Solaia, one of Italy’s most sought-after labels, as well as Tignanello and Guado al Tasso. The wines retail from €150, but some of the rarest vintages can fetch thousands of euros per bottle. The theft is the latest in a series in Italy, following another in July at the renowned Banfi winery in Montalcino. While such crimes have traditionally involved smaller quantities or a handful of high-value bottles, from restaurants, private cellars or during distribution, recent cases have involved larger stocks held at wineries. Florence-based Antinori said surveillance camera footage showed seven masked men entering its storage facility in Cortona last weekend and disabling its alarm systems before loading thousands of cases of the Tuscan red wines onto two trucks. Antinori said the timing and execution of the theft, which was discovered on Monday morning when staff arrived at the warehouse and is now being investigated by Italian police, suggested a highly organized group was involved. The operation was facilitated by the fact that the wines had been prepared for a shipment to foreign distributors, allowing the thieves to remove a large quantity of high-value bottles quickly, a representative for Antinori told Reuters. (Reporting by Giulia Segreti; Editing by Alvise Armellini and Alexander Smith)

item.title: Fury-Joshua showdown sells out in an hour as demand surges, say media reports
item.description: Tickets for Tyson Fury's long-awaited heavyweight clash with Anthony Joshua at Cardiff's Principality Stadium sold out within an hour of going on sale on Friday, British media reported.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Tickets for Tyson Fury's long-awaited heavyweight clash with Anthony Joshua at Cardiff's Principality Stadium sold out within an hour of going on sale on Friday, British media reported. The all-British bout, announced last month, has generated huge interest and has been billed as the [USN:L6N45M19C TEXT:"biggest in British boxing history"]. Around 80,000 tickets went on sale at midday, with prices ranging from £88.50 pounds ($117) to £13,128 ($17,357) including booking fees, the BBC reported. More than 500,000 fans were reportedly in the online queue within minutes of sales opening. Fury and Joshua are scheduled to headline a December 11 card, although their [USN:L6N45U10G TEXT:"ring walks"] are expected to begin at around 1 a.m. on December 12. According to an application submitted to Cardiff City Council, Principality Stadium would remain open until 3.30 a.m. on December 12. The fight between the former world champions is being broadcast on Netflix and Saudi money man Turki Alalshikh had hoped initially that it could be staged at New York's Madison Square Garden. The contest will mark the first meeting between the former world heavyweight champions, ending years of speculation over a matchup that many feared might never happen. ($1 = 0.7564 pounds)

item.title: Trump lanza panel para investigar a Lisa Cook de la Fed: comunicado de la Casa Blanca
item.description: El presidente de Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, anunció la creación de una comisión para investigar a la gobernadora de la Reserva Federal Lisa Cook según un comunicado publicado el viernes en la página web de la Casa Blanca.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El presidente de Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, anunció la creación de una comisión para investigar a la gobernadora de la Reserva Federal Lisa Cook según un comunicado publicado el viernes en la página web de la Casa Blanca. "Para ayudarme a cumplir con esa responsabilidad, la comisión investigará las acusaciones contra la gobernadora Cook y me informará de si existen “motivos” para la destitución de la gobernadora Cook", según el comunicado, con fecha del 7 de octubre.

item.title: US consumer sentiment deteriorates further in October
item.description: US consumer sentiment deteriorated further in early October as rising prices because of the Middle East conflict soured households' views of the economy, a survey showed on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: US consumer sentiment deteriorated further in early October as rising prices because of the Middle East conflict soured households' views of the economy, a survey showed on Friday. The University of Michigan's Surveys of Consumers said its Consumer Sentiment Index dropped to 46.3 this month from a final reading of 48.1 in September. Economists polled by Reuters had forecast the index at 47.8. "Frustration over cost-of-living continues to mount, as consumers across the political spectrum believe that the trajectory of the economy has weakened since the beginning of the year," said Joanne Hsu, the director of the Surveys of Consumers. "Overall, sentiment for lower-income consumers and those with smaller stock portfolios dropped steeply this month, groups that have fewer resources to weather increases in prices." The survey's measure of consumer expectations for inflation over the next year nudged up to 4.7% from 4.6% in September. Twelve-month inflation expectations have surged from 3.4% in February before the US-Israeli war with Iran started. Consumers' expectations for inflation over the next five years rose to 3.5% from 3.4% in September.

item.title: Construtoras sobem após prévias do trimestre indicarem crescimento de vendas
item.description: As ações de construtoras listadas no Ibovespa avançavam na abertura do pregão desta sexta-feira após a publicação de dados preliminares do terceiro trimestre.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: As ações de construtoras listadas no Ibovespa avançavam na abertura do pregão desta sexta-feira após a publicação de dados preliminares do terceiro trimestre. A MRV Engenharia e Participações (MRVE3.SA) liderava os ganhos do setor com valorização de 5,3% às 10h35, a R$6,77 por ação ordinária, se encaminhando para um ganho semanal de 20%. O grupo imobiliário e de construção [USN:L1N45U14O TEXT:"encerrou"] o terceiro trimestre com geração de caixa de R$456 milhões e elevou as vendas líquidas em 29,6%, para R$3 bilhões, com o valor médio dos apartamentos vendidos subindo 3,1%, para R$276 mil, segundo dados divulgados na véspera. Analistas do Itaú BBA afirmaram em nota que a MRV apresentou um desempenho misto para o período, mas com ritmo de vendas sólido, embora os números tenham sido inflacionados por mudança na metodologia de reconhecimento de vendas da empresa. A Construtora Tenda (TEND3.SA) avançava 3,15%, a R$30,42, a caminho de um ganho semanal de 7,5%, após [USN:L1N45V08M TEXT:"registrar"] crescimento de 4,4% nas vendas do período, totalizando R$1,29 bilhão. Já a Cury (CURY3.SA) subia 3,1% para R$32,45 na abertura do pregão e se encaminhava para uma valorização semanal de 17%. A construtora e incorporadora anunciou [USN:L1N45U116 TEXT:"crescimento"] de 10,7% nas vendas líquidas do terceiro trimestre, atingindo R$1,8 bilhão. O valor médio dos apartamentos vendidos foi de R$322,8 mil, alta de 7,7% sobre um ano antes. Em nota, os analistas do Itaú BBA destacaram que os resultados da Cury foram melhores do que o previsto. Segundo Elvis Credendio e equipe, a Cury conseguiu manter uma sólida relação vendas/suprimento, enquanto a geração de caixa deve garantir, em grande parte, um ritmo sólido de crescimento dos lucros e sustentar uma valorização atraente.

item.title: Insider: BASF-Offerte für Evonik "nicht das letzte Wort"
item.description: Der Chemieriese BASF will Insidern zufolge im Ringen um eine Übernahme des Konkurrenten Evonik nicht lockerlassen. "Man kann davon ausgehen, dass die aktuelle Offerte nicht das letzte Wort ist", sagte ein Insider im Umfeld des Ludwigshafener Dax-Konzerns am Freitag der Nachrichtenagentur Reuters. Wenn BASF mit Evonik ins Gespräch komme, sei eine Aufstockung der Offerte möglich, sagte eine zweite mit dem Vorgang vertraute Person. Die Aussagen dürften beim Evonik-Großaktionär RAG-Stiftung auf Interesse stoßen. Das Kuratorium der Kohle-Stiftung war am Mittag zu Beratungen zusammengekommen. "Das Kuratorium der RAG-Stiftung (hat sich)über das Übernahmeinteresse der BASF an Evonik vom Vorstand der RAG-Stiftung informieren lassen", teilte die Stiftung danach mit. Zu Details äußerte sie sich nicht.
item.dc:creator: Matthias Inverardi
item.content:encoded: Der Chemieriese BASF (BASFn.DE) will Insidern zufolge im Ringen um eine Übernahme des Konkurrenten Evonik (EVKn.DE) nicht lockerlassen. "Man kann davon ausgehen, dass die aktuelle Offerte nicht das letzte Wort ist", sagte ein Insider im Umfeld des Ludwigshafener Dax-Konzerns am Freitag der Nachrichtenagentur Reuters. Wenn BASF mit Evonik ins Gespräch komme, sei eine Aufstockung der Offerte möglich, sagte eine zweite mit dem Vorgang vertraute Person. Die Aussagen dürften beim Evonik-Großaktionär RAG-Stiftung auf Interesse stoßen. Das Kuratorium der Kohle-Stiftung war am Mittag zu Beratungen zusammengekommen. "Das Kuratorium der RAG-Stiftung (hat sich)über das Übernahmeinteresse der BASF an Evonik vom Vorstand der RAG-Stiftung informieren lassen", teilte die Stiftung danach mit. Zu Details äußerte sie sich nicht. BASF erwäge auch Zusagen an die Evonik-Belegschaft - unter anderem mit Blick auf Standorte, sagte ein Insider weiter. Im Umfeld der BASF wurde begrüßt, dass der Evonik-Großaktionär sich mit dem Interesse des Konzerns an Evonik beschäftigt habe, sagte eine weitere mit dem Vorgang vertraute Person aus dem Umfeld des Chemieriesen. Ein Gremium des BASF-Aufsichtsrats berate ebenfalls über den Sachstand, hieß es weiter. BASF wollte die Angaben nicht kommentieren. Ein Evonik-Sprecher sagte, es gebe weiter keine Gespräche mit BASF. BASF und der Essener Spezialchemiekonzern Evonik hatten im September Sondierungsgespräche bestätigt. Evonik hatte Insidern zufolge aber Ende September ein erstes Übernahmeangebot des größeren Rivalen abgewiesen. BASF habe damals rund 22,15 Euro je Evonik-Aktie geboten, hatten Insider gesagt. Das Essener Unternehmen wurde damit inklusive Schulden mit rund 14 Milliarden Euro bewertet - Evonik reichte dies nicht aus. Eine Schlüsselrolle bei einem möglichen Zusammenschluss fällt der RAG-Stiftung zu, die rund 43 Prozent an Evonik hält. Auch sie hatte bestätigt, von BASF angesprochen worden zu sein. Sie hatte zudem erklärt, sich von ihrem [USN:L8N45M1OO TEXT:"kompletten Anteil"] an Evonik trennen zu können. "Gemäß Stiftungssatzung ist eine Komplettveräußerung der Evonik möglich", teilte die Essener Stiftung noch Ende September mit. Zuvor hatte sie stets erklärt, ihren Anteil auf eine Sperrminorität von 25,1 Prozent abschmelzen zu wollen. Das Kuratorium beaufsichtigt die Stiftung, die mit ihrem Milliardenvermögen für die Folgekosten des beendeten Steinkohlebergbaus aufkommen muss. Das Kuratorium der Stiftung wird von Politikern und Gewerkschaftern geprägt. Vorsitzender ist der CDU-Politiker Armin Laschet. Auch NRW-Ministerpräsident Hendrik Wüst, die saarländische Regierungschefin Anke Rehlinger, Bundesfinanzminister Lars Klingbeil, Bundeswirtschaftsministerin Katherina Reiche und IG-BCE-Chef Michael Vassiliadis gehören dem Gremium unter anderem an. "Die Arbeitsplätze und die eigenständige Entwicklung des Unternehmens dürfen nicht in Frage gestellt werden", hatte die [USN:L8N45R103 TEXT:"NRW-Landesregierung"] bereits erklärt. "Mit Blick auf die Arbeitsplätze in Nordrhein-Westfalen und die zukünftige strategische Entwicklung ... verfolgt die Landesregierung die aktuelle Debatte sehr aufmerksam", hatte ein Sprecher der Staatskanzlei gesagt. Evonik sei Arbeitgeber für mehr als 11.000 Beschäftigte in dem Bundesland. Wüst habe sich für das Treffen des Kuratoriums am Freitag eingesetzt, sagte ein Insider. Er wird in NRW unter anderem von der NRW-SPD unter Druck gesetzt, die sich für einen Einstieg des Staates bei Evonik einsetzt. Das Thema wird am kommenden Mittwoch im NRW-Landtag erörtert. Für die Beschäftigten und Standorte beider Konzerne müsse es Zukunftsperspektiven und Investitionszusagen geben, hatte die Gewerkschaft IG BCE gefordert. BASF ist nun offenbar bereit, mit Zusagen an die Belegschaft Evoniks auf die Bedenken einzugehen. Die Essener beschäftigen weltweit etwa 31.000 Menschen, bei BASF sind es rund 95.000.

item.title: EU says it agrees with China to halve hybrid vehicle exports to EU
item.description: The European Union and China have agreed to halve Chinese exports of hybrid and plug-in hybrid vehicles to the EU, improve EU access to China's market and ease Chinese licencing of rare earth exports, European Trade Commissioner Maros Sefcovic said on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The European Union and China have agreed to halve Chinese exports of hybrid and plug-in hybrid vehicles to the EU, improve EU access to China's market and ease Chinese licencing of rare earth exports, European Trade Commissioner Maros Sefcovic said on Friday. "This is far from the end. It's a crucial first step, but only a first step," Sefcovic told reporters in Beijing where he traveled to hold talks with his Chinese counterpart. European Trade Commissioner Maros Sefcovic has said he was seeking "tangible results" from his visit to China, amid the bloc's growing concerns over the gap, which amounted to over €1 billion ($1.12 billion) a day.

item.title: Apple reduz pedidos de itens do iPhone 18 Pro devido à fraca demanda, diz Nikkei Asia
item.description: A Apple instruiu alguns fornecedores a reduzir a produção de componentes para seus recém-lançados iPhone 18 Pro e iPhone 18 Pro Max, já que a alta nos custos dos chips de memória e os aumentos de preço enfraqueceram a demanda dos consumidores, informou o Nikkei Asia nesta sexta-feira.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A Apple (AAPL.O) instruiu alguns fornecedores a reduzir a produção de componentes para seus recém-lançados iPhone 18 Pro e iPhone 18 Pro Max, já que a alta nos custos dos chips de memória e os aumentos de preço enfraqueceram a demanda dos consumidores, informou o Nikkei Asia nesta sexta-feira. A fabricante do iPhone adotou uma postura mais conservadora em relação às remessas desde o início de setembro, com os pedidos de componentes para outubro sendo reduzidos em pelo menos 15% em comparação com o que havia sido solicitado originalmente, informou o Nikkei, citando várias pessoas a par do assunto. A Reuters não conseguiu verificar a informação imediatamente. A Apple não respondeu de imediato a um pedido de comentário da Reuters fora do horário comercial normal. As empresas de tecnologia vêm adquirindo capacidade avançada de fabricação de chips para alimentar centros de dados de IA, provocando escassez e aumentos de preços que devem reduzir tanto o mercado de computadores pessoais quanto o de smartphones este ano. A Apple aumentou os preços do iPad e do MacBook em junho, afirmando que não poderia mais proteger os clientes dos custos crescentes dos chips de memória e armazenamento, impulsionados pela expansão dos data centers do setor de IA. A demanda por dispositivos tem estado mais fraca desde o final de agosto, mas isso pode estar relacionado à mudança da Apple em seu cronograma de lançamento dos modelos do iPhone, informou o Nikkei. No mês passado, a Apple revelou a última geração de seu smartphone carro-chefe, com os modelos iPhone 18 Pro e 18 Pro Max, juntamente com seu telefone dobrável, o Duo. O iPhone 18 Pro e o Pro Max custam a partir de US$1.199 e US$1.299, respectivamente, um aumento de US$100 em relação aos preços iniciais do iPhone 17 Pro e do Pro Max. À medida que mais recursos de IA são adicionados aos iPhones e a outros produtos, a demanda da Apple por memória de alto desempenho aumentou, elevando o papel estratégico dos fornecedores em meio a uma escassez global.

item.title: 盗難のルノワール絵画を回収、6人逮捕 仏南部
item.description: [パリ ９日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[パリ ９日 ロイター] - フランス南部リビエラ地方カーニュシュルメールにあるルノワール美術館で９月、印象派の巨匠ルノワールの絵画２点が盗まれた事件で、地元市長は９日、数百万ドル相当とされる２点が回収され、容疑者６人を逮捕したと発表した。

これら２点は「コロンナ・ロマーノ夫人の肖像」と「井戸のそばの若い女性」。いずれもパリのオルセー美術館が所蔵し、ルノワール美術館に寄託されていた。

９月に発生した事件では、犯行グループはフェンスに穴を開けて美術館に侵入し、絵画４点を盗んだ。駆け付けた警察が追跡し、犯人らは逃走中に庭へ２点を落とし、そのまま逃げ去った。

マルセイユ検察庁は、残る２点がどのように回収されたかとの質問には回答していない。

item.title: ICC prosecutor condemns US sanctions, says work will continue
item.description: US sanctions against the International Criminal Court announced on Friday "must be condemned" and will not halt the tribunal's work, its deputy prosecutor, Nazhat Shameem Khan, told Reuters.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: US sanctions against the International Criminal Court announced on Friday "must be condemned" and will not halt the tribunal's work, its deputy prosecutor, Nazhat Shameem Khan, told Reuters. "The sanctions are intended to undermine the rule of law internationally and the work that an independent judicial institution is doing," Khan said. "Our work will continue across all our situations, our investigations and our prosecutions."

item.title: ICE officials defend shooting of New York man, attack 'sanctuary' policies
item.description: US immigration officials on Friday defended federal agents who shot and wounded a New York City man in his car with a young child believed to be his son in the back seat, an incident that the city's mayor, Zohran Mamdani, called an "outrage."
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: US immigration officials on Friday defended federal agents who shot and wounded a New York City man in his car with a young child believed to be his son in the back seat, an incident that the city's mayor, Zohran Mamdani, called an "outrage." At a press conference, US Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin said officers did not know the child was in the car at the time they opened fire and accused the man, a Dominican who was the target of the operation, of endangering both officers and the child by using his car as a weapon. The shooting took place on Thursday afternoon in the residential neighborhood of Marble Hill, when Immigration and Customs Enforcement officers attempted to arrest a man identified by authorities as Oscar Belgal. Belgal refused to exit his car when approached by officers and then accelerated his car, struck two ICE vehicles and "weaponized" his vehicle by driving it toward other officers, Marcos Charles, a senior ICE official, said at a press conference on Friday. Officers opened fire, and Belgal suffered a superficial wound to his neck, Charles said. He is being held in a detention facility outside New York state. Belgal's five-year-old son was in the back seat at the time, according to police. Video of the shooting, including body camera footage, has not been made public. In other violent incidents, initial accounts from ICE or the Department of Homeland Security have [USN:L6N3YR1BT TEXT:"repeatedly been contradicted"] by video and other evidence, sometimes in court. Mullin said the body camera footage would eventually be released. Belgal is a Dominican who is in the country illegally, according to US officials. He has a criminal record, including a conviction for grand larceny, which led to a sentence of five years' probation in April 2025, Charles said. Speaking to reporters late on Thursday at the scene of the shooting, Mamdani said he had tried unsuccessfully to secure Belgal's release in phone calls with President Donald Trump and Mullin. "These actions are making the city less safe," Mamdani said. "We want ICE out of our city, ICE out of our schools, ICE out of our hospitals, ICE out of our streets, ICE away from our kids." In response on Friday, Mullin attacked Mamdani and criticized New York's "sanctuary" policies, which restrict how much city agencies and police cooperate with immigration authorities, for allowing Belgal to be out on the streets instead of turning him over to federal agents. Belgal was arrested on drug charges in 2025, a case that is still pending, according to the city's police commissioner.

item.title: La Chine et l'UE parviennent s'entendent sur les véhicules hybrides
item.description: La Chine et l'Union européenne sont parvenues à un "accord" sur le commerce des véhicules hybrides, a annoncé vendredi le ministère chinois du Commerce, à l'issue de deux jours de négociations au cours desquelles l'UE a cherché à réduire son déficit commercial avec Pékin.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: La Chine et l'Union européenne sont parvenues à un "accord" sur le commerce des véhicules hybrides, a annoncé vendredi le ministère chinois du Commerce, à l'issue de deux jours de négociations au cours desquelles l'UE a cherché à réduire son déficit commercial avec Pékin. Le commissaire européen au Commerce, Maros Sefcovic, avait déclaré avoir l'espoir de revenir avec des "résultats concrets" de sa [USN:L6N45T0YP TEXT:"visite"] en Chine. Le déficit commercial de l'UE dans ses échanges avec la Chine s'élève à plus d’un milliard d'euros. L'accord sur un commerce des véhicules hybrides conforme aux règles de l'OMC (Organisation mondiale du commerce) a été le fruit d'intenses négociations a précisé le ministère du Commerce chinois, sans donner plus de détails. Les responsables de l'UE s'inquiètent de la forte hausse des importations de voitures en provenance de Chine. Et le nombre record de marques chinoises - 20 - qui seront présentes au [USN:L6N45U145 TEXT:"Mondial de l'Auto"] de Paris la semaine prochaine, souligne la rapidité avec laquelle les constructeurs chinois se sont imposés comme une menace concurrentielle en Europe malgré la multiplication des barrières commerciales. Les marques chinoises ont ainsi représenté plus de 26% du marché des hybrides rechargeables en Europe occidentale au deuxième trimestre 2026, contre seulement 2,2% à la même période deux ans auparavant. Les discussions entre le ministre du Commerce Wang Wentao et Maros Sefcovic, qui se sont tenues jeudi et vendredi à Pékin, ont été "pragmatiques et productives", a encore dit le ministère chinois.

item.title: Kenya approves $350 million shareholder financing for Kenya Airways
item.description: Kenya's cabinet has approved $350 million in shareholder financing for Kenya Airways to meet urgent financial obligations, President William Ruto's office said on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Kenya's cabinet has approved $350 million in shareholder financing for Kenya Airways (KQNA.NR) to meet urgent financial obligations, President William Ruto's office said on Friday. The government is the largest shareholder in the [USN:L8N44M0X1 TEXT:"loss-making"] airline, which is in the process of seeking strategic investors as it looks for fresh capital Kenya Airways says that part of its [USN:L8N44N0F4 TEXT:"restructuring plan"] includes cleaning up its balance sheet, including the possible conversion into equity of principal debt owed to the Kenyan government and a consortium of local banks The cabinet also endorsed a proposed conversion of Kenya Airways' 122 billion Kenyan shillings ($941 million) in government loans into an equity-qualifying tradable instrument, Ruto's office said in a statement The funds will be released in batches under the finance ministry's oversight with a repayment period of up to 10 years and the possibility of conversion into equity, subject to the necessary approvals ($1 = 129.6000 Kenyan shillings)

item.title: Trump launches committee to probe Fed's Lisa Cook, White House says
item.description: US President Donald Trump has formed a committee to investigate Fed Governor Lisa Cook over allegations she made false statements in connection with mortgages, according to a notice on the White House website on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: US President Donald Trump has formed a committee to investigate Fed Governor Lisa Cook over allegations she made false statements in connection with mortgages, according to a notice on the White House website on Friday. "To assist me in carrying out that responsibility, the Committee shall investigate the allegations against Governor Cook and report to me whether there is 'cause' for Governor Cook’s removal," according to the notice, dated October 7. The committee will hold an in-person hearing at the White House "to consider the evidence and allegations against Governor Cook," the presidential memorandum said. It said the hearing would last no longer than four hours. Trump tried to fire Cook, the first Black woman to serve on the central bank's board, a year ago. The case led to the US Supreme Court [USN:S0N3WN0AW TEXT:"ruling"] that the president could not remove a Fed governor without adequate cause and needed to follow a clear process to lay out the reasons and provide evidence. The ruling left Cook in her position but kicked the case against her back to a federal district court. Cook was appointed to the Fed board in 2022 by former President Joe Biden, a Democrat, and was reappointed in 2023 to a term that lasts until 2038.

item.title: Poupança tem saque líquido de R$9,350 bi em agosto, diz BC
item.description: A caderneta de poupança no Brasil registrou em setembro retiradas líquidas de R$9,350 bilhões, mostraram dados do Banco Central divulgados nesta sexta-feira.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A caderneta de poupança no Brasil registrou em setembro retiradas líquidas de R$9,350 bilhões, mostraram dados do Banco Central divulgados nesta sexta-feira. Esse foi o quarto mês seguido de saques depois de terem sido registrados depósitos em maio -- único mês no ano com entradas líquidas na poupança até agora. A aplicação tem registrado perdas anuais consecutivas de recursos desde 2021, com a grande maioria dos meses apresentando resultados negativos. No mês passado, houve um saldo negativo de R$6,186 bilhões no Sistema Brasileiro de Poupança e Empréstimo (SBPE), enquanto a poupança rural teve saques líquidos de R$3,164 bilhões. No ano, a poupança acumula saques líquidos de R$66,432 bilhões até setembro. A rentabilidade atual da caderneta de poupança é dada pela taxa referencial (TR) mais uma remuneração fixa de 0,5% ao mês. Essa fórmula vale enquanto a taxa Selic estiver acima de 8,5% ao ano -- a taxa básica de juros está atualmente em 13,75% ao ano.

item.title: Recebimento de amêndoas de cacau pela indústria do Brasil sobe 25,3% em 2025/26, diz AIPC
item.description: O recebimento de amêndoas de cacau pela indústria no Brasil totalizou 226.497 toneladas entre outubro de 2025 e setembro de 2026, crescimento de 25,3% em relação ao ciclo anterior, de acordo com dados divulgados nesta sexta-feira pela Associação Nacional das Indústrias Processadoras de Cacau (AIPC).
item.dc:creator: Oliver Griffin
item.content:encoded: O recebimento de amêndoas de cacau pela indústria no Brasil totalizou 226.497 toneladas entre outubro de 2025 e setembro de 2026, crescimento de 25,3% em relação ao ciclo anterior, de acordo com dados divulgados nesta sexta-feira pela Associação Nacional das Indústrias Processadoras de Cacau (AIPC). A informação indica que a melhora da disponibilidade de cacau nacional ao longo de 2026 se confirmou, enquanto as importações despencaram. Já a moagem avançou no acumulado do ano até setembro. "Os resultados representam sinais positivos para a cadeia, mas a consolidação desse movimento dependerá da continuidade da produção nos próximos ciclos e de uma recuperação consistente da demanda", disse a presidente-executiva da AIPC, Anna Paula Losi, em nota. No terceiro trimestre, o recebimento alcançou 71.652 toneladas, alta de 7,7% em relação ao segundo trimestre e de 5,0% em relação ao mesmo período de 2025. Foi o maior volume de um terceiro trimestre na série de 2023 a 2026. O resultado acompanha a sazonalidade da safra que concentra volumes maiores de cacau entre abril e setembro. Já a moagem de cacau no Brasil somou 53.743 toneladas no terceiro trimestre, um crescimento de 8,1% em relação ao segundo trimestre e de 16,4% em relação ao mesmo período de 2025. No acumulado de janeiro a setembro, o processamento alcançou 155.169 toneladas, alta de 7,7% frente a 2025, mas ainda 8,6% abaixo de 2024 e 18,5% inferior a 2023. "A moagem apresentou uma reação importante no terceiro trimestre, acompanhada pelo avanço das exportações de derivados. Ainda assim, o processamento acumulado permanece significativamente abaixo dos níveis de 2023 e 2024", disse a executiva. "Para que a maior oferta de cacau se traduza em mais atividade industrial, renda e empregos, a demanda por derivados precisa se recuperar de forma consistente", acrescentou ela. A associação informou ainda que pelo segundo trimestre consecutivo não houve importação de amêndoas de cacau. Todo o volume importado entre janeiro e setembro de 2026, de 18.068 toneladas, ingressou no primeiro trimestre, representando uma queda de 57,1% em relação ao mesmo período de 2025. A ausência de importações nos dois últimos trimestres ocorre em um cenário de maior disponibilidade de matéria-prima nacional e de moagem ainda inferior aos patamares anteriores à crise, segundo a associação.

item.title: Fed says household income, wealth, debt stress rose from 2022 to 2025
item.description: The exit from the COVID-19 pandemic raised incomes and wealth for most US households, with income gains concentrated among the less well off, but a growing share of households was stressed by rising debt during a period of high inflation, a Federal Reserve survey of consumer finances from 2022 to 2025 showed.
item.dc:creator: Howard Schneider
item.content:encoded: The exit from the COVID-19 pandemic raised incomes and wealth for most US households, with income gains concentrated among the less well off, but a growing share of households was stressed by rising debt during a period of high inflation, a Federal Reserve survey of consumer finances from 2022 to 2025 showed. "Against this backdrop of moderate economic expansion and elevated inflation ... while most families experienced moderate increases in income and net worth, an increasing subset of families appear to have been experiencing financial stress," with the share of families having debt payment-to-income ratios of 40% or more rising from 6.5% to 8.6%, a level not seen since 2013, the Fed said on Friday in its latest triennial survey. Median family income adjusted for inflation rose 7% to $82,200 during the period, when the tight labor market of the pandemic gradually gave way to a small rise in unemployment. Households at the lower end of the income distribution saw the largest gains, consistent with conditions in the post-pandemic era, when firms were short of workers, particularly in the services sector, and employers offered pay hikes and bonuses to attract and retain employees. Real median net worth rose 2% to $215,900, and "most families across the net worth and income distributions experienced increases," the Fed said in a press release accompanying the document. The homeownership rate remained stable at about 66%, while participation in the stock market dropped slightly from 58% in 2022 to 56% in 2025. The survey covered a national sample of 4,367 households and was conducted mostly from April through December 2025. The slight narrowing of income inequality and overall broad wealth gains occurred while net worth for Black families and the less well off declined. Families in the bottom quartile of wealth saw their net worth drop from $3,800 to $1,700, while "Black non-Hispanic families experienced a large decline in median net worth" of 25%, even though their average net worth rose about 5%. That trend reversed a pattern of gains seen since 2013, the Fed said.

item.title: US imposes sanctions on ICC hours after former judge wins Nobel Peace Prize
item.description: US President Donald Trump's administration imposed sanctions on the International Criminal Court on Friday, hours after one of its former judges won the Nobel Peace Prize, putting Washington on a diplomatic collision course with European allies.
item.dc:creator: Humeyra Pamuk, Steve Holland, Anthony Deutsch
item.content:encoded: US President Donald Trump's administration imposed sanctions on the International Criminal Court on Friday, hours after one of its [USN:L8N45V0JG TEXT:"former judges won the Nobel Peace Prize"], putting Washington on a diplomatic collision course with European allies. The ICC's deputy prosecutor, Nazhat Shameem Khan, condemned the sanctions and said they would not halt the tribunal's work. The Trump administration has long been hostile to the court and has previously imposed sanctions on its prosecutors and judges. Friday's move would go far further, by potentially punishing companies that provide services to the court itself. "President Trump will never allow the International Criminal Court to prosecute Americans," Secretary of State Marco Rubio said in a statement reviewed by Reuters ahead of the official announcement. "That is why, today, the United States is sanctioning the International Criminal Court. We will ban transactions with this rogue court, cutting off their resources and crippling its ability to operate." ICC Deputy Prosecutor Khan told Reuters the sanctions "must be condemned". "The sanctions are intended to undermine the rule of law internationally and the work that an independent judicial institution is doing," Khan said. "Our work will continue across all our situations, our investigations and our prosecutions." Washington has long been angry over ICC arrest warrants issued for Israeli officials including Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, and over a past investigation into actions of US soldiers in Afghanistan which the ICC has since closed. The court, founded in 2002 [USN:L6N3VQ0DE TEXT:"to prosecute war crimes, crimes against humanity and genocide"], counts 125 countries as member states, including all EU countries and all members of the NATO alliance apart from the United States and Turkey. It has received strong public backing in the past from member countries including major US allies, and is based in the Netherlands, an EU and NATO member. Navi Pillay, the South African jurist who won the Nobel Peace Prize on Friday for her work in international criminal justice, served as a judge on the ICC's Appeals Chamber from 2003-2008. In its citation, the prize committee said it had sought to "issue a reminder" at a time when "judges and institutions of international law are under political attack". "An international legal system in which war criminals are held to account and the victims of abuse see justice served is a precondition for a peaceful world," the committee said. Rubio said the sanctions had been structured to give the court and its member states an opportunity to address US concerns. He did not provide further details, but a senior State Department official said the US Treasury would issue a set of licenses "to protect American interests", an apparent reference to temporary exemptions to some sanctions. US EXPECTS ALLIES TO 'REIN IN THE COURT' US sanctions typically bar all US-based companies from any work with a sanctioned organization, forcing banks to shut accounts, insurers to end coverage and software companies to halt cooperation. The Trump administration previously imposed targeted sanctions on court officials during his first term, which were rescinded under President Joe Biden. Washington announced new sanctions just days after Trump returned to office in January 2025. Court officials have been preparing for months for the prospect of [USN:L6N45D0HW TEXT:"sanctions on the court"] itself, shifting office computers from Microsoft software to open source equivalents and making new arrangements for banking and health insurance. The court's registrar Osvaldo Zavala Giler called earlier this week for the EU to be prepared to use a so-called "blocking mechanism" that lets it shield European countries from the extra-territorial effects of sanctions. In his statement, Rubio said the United States had delayed its sanctions hoping that the ICC and the countries party to its founding Rome Statute would address US concerns, but they had failed to do so. "Either the ICC will end its threats, or we will end the ICC. We expect our allies, many of whom are part of the ICC and that rely on American servicemembers for their defense, to rein in the court," Rubio said. "We have structured this action to provide an opportunity for States Parties to negotiate and present a solution to address our concerns. If these efforts do not bear fruit, we will continue to adjust accordingly," Rubio said.

item.title: Mais da metade de jogadores e dirigentes monitorados receberam mensagens ofensivas, diz Fifa
item.description: Mais da metade dos 1.606 jogadores, técnicos e dirigentes monitorados pelo Serviço de Proteção nas Redes Sociais (SMPS) da Fifa na Copa do Mundo de 2026 foram vítimas de abusos online, informou a Fifa nesta sexta-feira.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Mais da metade dos 1.606 jogadores, técnicos e dirigentes monitorados pelo Serviço de Proteção nas Redes Sociais (SMPS) da Fifa na Copa do Mundo de 2026 foram vítimas de abusos online, informou a Fifa nesta sexta-feira. 812 das 1.606 pessoas monitoradas receberam pelo menos uma mensagem classificada como abusiva. O racismo foi a forma mais comum de abuso discriminatório, representando 12% do total de insultos e 20% quando excluídos os abusos de natureza geral. A pessoa mais visada recebeu mais de 10.000 publicações abusivas, 40% delas racistas. O SMPS analisou 17,1 milhões de publicações e comentários, dos quais cerca de 240 mil foram confirmados como abusivos após análise humana. 2.905 contas foram encaminhadas para investigação e 786 foram encaminhadas às autoridades policiais para análise. A ferramenta de moderação analisou 60,7 milhões de comentários nos canais oficiais da Fifa e das federações membros e ocultou 9,2 milhões, incluindo spam.

item.title: Organismo de aviación de la UE amplía advertencia sobre espacio aéreo saudí tras ataques hutíes
item.description: La Agencia Europea de Seguridad Aérea (EASA) anunció el viernes que había ampliado la zona del espacio aéreo de Arabia Saudita en la que recomendaba a las compañías aéreas no operar, tras el ataque de los hutíes de Yemen —aliados de Irán— al aeropuerto de Riad.
item.dc:creator: Gianluca Lo Nostro
item.content:encoded: La Agencia Europea de Seguridad Aérea (EASA) anunció el viernes que había ampliado la zona del espacio aéreo de Arabia Saudita en la que recomendaba a las compañías aéreas no operar, tras el ataque de los hutíes de Yemen —aliados de Irán— al aeropuerto de Riad. En una actualización del boletín informativo sobre zonas de conflicto publicado por primera vez el 30 de septiembre, el organismo regulador de la Unión Europea señaló que los recientes ataques muestran la capacidad e intención de los hutíes de atacar objetivos situados más al interior del territorio saudí, incluida la capital. La EASA añadió a la advertencia una zona del noroeste de Arabia Saudita . La autoridad de aviación civil de Arabia Saudita había informado ese mismo viernes de que tres ciudadanos sauditas fallecieron y varias personas resultaron heridas en dos ataques perpetrados el jueves contra el Aeropuerto Internacional Rey Jalid de Riad. Los hutíes han renovado sus amenazas contra las aerolíneas que vuelan a Arabia Saudita y afirmaron el jueves que atacaron el aeropuerto de la capital con dos misiles de crucero. "Estos recurrentes ataques con misiles y drones, junto con la activación de los sistemas de defensa aérea, aumentan el riesgo de identificación errónea de aeronaves civiles, así como los riesgos asociados al sobrevuelo de misiles y drones, a las actividades de intercepción y a la caída de escombros", señaló la EASA. OPSGROUP, una organización que cuenta con casi 10.000 profesionales de la aviación y que comparte información sobre riesgos de vuelo, envió el viernes a sus miembros una advertencia de "no volar" sobre Arabia Saudita, citando los riesgos de ataques continuados con misiles y de "errores de juicio" en las respuestas defensivas. "Ahora recomendamos evitar por completo las operaciones en Arabia Saudita, incluido el uso de los aeropuertos saudíes como alternativos en ruta", señaló en el memorándum compartido con Reuters. Tras los ataques del jueves, el Grupo Lufthansa y tres aerolíneas indias anunciaron que suspenderían los vuelos con destino a Riad previstos para los próximos días.

item.title: Germania vuole posto in organi direttivi Bce - Klingbeil
item.description: La Germania vuole continuare a essere "fortemente rappresentata" negli organi direttivi della Banca centrale europea anche in futuro.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: La Germania vuole continuare a essere "fortemente rappresentata" negli organi direttivi della Banca centrale europea anche in futuro. Lo ha affermato a Lussemburgo il ministro delle Finanze tedesco Lars Klingbeil, a margine di una riunione dei ministri delle Finanze. "Mi sto coordinando strettamente con la Cancelleria federale su tutte le questioni relative alla Bce e, naturalmente, presenteremo un candidato tedesco", ha detto Klingbeil. Ieri i ministri delle Finanze della zona euro hanno avviato un processo per sostituire Isabel Schnabel, membro del comitato esecutivo della Banca centrale europea, che lascerà l'istituto il 3 gennaio per il Fondo monetario internazionale. "Durante i colloqui bilaterali, ho notato che tutti i colleghi sono ben consapevoli del ruolo che la Germania riveste in seno alla Bce", ha aggiunto Klingbeil.

item.title: IMF reaches staff-level agreement with Zambia on new credit facility
item.description: The IMF said on Friday it had reached a staff-level agreement with Zambia on a new extended credit facility arrangement for the southern African country.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The IMF said on Friday it had reached a staff-level agreement with Zambia on a new extended credit facility arrangement for the southern African country. The proposed arrangement would support Zambia's efforts to safeguard macroeconomic stability and debt sustainability as well as its balance-of-payments and fiscal financing needs, the International Monetary Fund said in a statement. The country's previous $1.7 billion IMF programme, which helped it emerge from a prolonged debt crisis after becoming Africa's first COVID-19 pandemic-era sovereign default in 2020, expired in January. The new agreement, which will give Zambia access to 1,076 million Special Drawing Rights, comes as the country prepares its 2027 budget, with the finance ministry saying this week that government spending is projected to [USN:L8N45R0VC TEXT:"rise by 7%"].

item.title: ULTIM'ORA-UCRAINA: Delegazione Kiev a Miami per colloqui con Usa - fonte
